status: fixed before new fits; post-hoc development exploration after V1 final and earlier V2 screens were viewed
question: Do a distribution-aware 50/200-day SRT trend and a lagged Singapore 10-year government-bond yield add next-day SRT residual-return signal?
target: next SRT raw close log return; train Ridge on the completed-label residual after the realized distribution adjustment, then add only the preannounced adjustment at evaluation
evaluation: the original 378 development target dates in three forward folds; never evaluate or select on final_holdout

trend.index: causal SRT gross-distribution total-return index I_t=I_(t-1)*(C_t+D_t)/C_(t-1), starting at 1 on the first SRT date
trend.role: two endpoint context variables, not 200 LSTM timesteps

rate.source: MAS SGS Prices and Yields - Benchmark Issues, daily 10-Year Bond Yield, fixed 2021-11 to 2025-09 query
rate.availability: use only the latest MAS observation strictly before the SRT forecast date because a same-day publication time has not been established
features_at_forecast_close: latest prior 10-year yield minus latest published SORA, percentage points
latest prior 10-year yield minus its value five SRT trading days earlier, percentage points

sample: restrict all four groups to the same windows with both trend features and both rate features available; retain all 378 original evaluation dates; no fill of missing SRT or MAS values
ridge: flatten original 20x6 history, append 0/2/4 endpoint variables; fit x and y scalers on each training partition only; unpenalized intercept; inner last 15% of eligible outer training selects alpha, then full eligible outer training refits
advance_rule: one group beats both same-sample base Ridge and DivSchedule by at least 1% pooled raw-return RMSE, beats DivSchedule in at least 2/3 folds, and has pooled MAE no more than 1% above DivSchedule; only then plan matched LSTM/Fuzzy training
scope: four fixed groups, one alpha grid, no final-period scores, no revised features or thresholds after viewing results
